variables.name: action_creates_case
variables.description: The candidate tool call creates a new customer_case record.

variables.name: action_updates_case
variables.description: The candidate tool call updates an existing customer_case record (any field).

variables.name: action_short_desc_valid
variables.description: The candidate call supplies a non-empty short_description for the case whose length is between 30 and 120 characters inclusive.

variables.name: action_channel_valid
variables.description: The candidate call supplies a case channel argument whose value is one of web, email, phone, chat, social, alert, community.

variables.name: action_priority_valid
variables.description: The candidate call supplies case priority with one of critical, high, moderate, low; true when the requester gave no priority and the call supplies moderate.

variables.name: action_sets_product_on_case
variables.description: The candidate case-creation call includes a product id or installed_product id argument for the case.

variables.name: action_case_state_new
variables.description: The candidate case-creation call sets state to new, or omits state where the policy default new applies.

variables.name: action_changes_case_state
variables.description: The candidate call changes the state field of an existing case to a different value.

variables.name: action_state_transition_invalid
variables.description: The case's current state is known from the prior trajectory and the candidate's new state is not an allowed successor (new→in_progress/pending/resolved; in_progress→pending/resolved; pending→in_progress/resolved; resolved→closed; canceled).

variables.name: action_sets_state_closed
variables.description: The candidate call sets a case state to closed.

variables.name: action_closed_on_set
variables.description: The candidate call closing a case also supplies a closed_on timestamp argument.

variables.name: action_assigns_case_user
variables.description: The candidate call sets assigned_to on a case to a specific user.

variables.name: action_links_knowledge
variables.description: The candidate call creates a case_knowledge link between a knowledge article and a case.

variables.name: action_used_as_valid
variables.description: The candidate knowledge-link call supplies used_as with one of suggested, applied, resolution.

variables.name: action_sets_escalation_true
variables.description: The candidate call sets escalation = true on a case.

variables.name: action_escalation_reason_set
variables.description: The same candidate escalation call supplies escalation_reason with one of urgency, vip, impact, breach_risk, customer_request.

variables.name: action_attaches_installed_product
variables.description: The candidate call sets or attaches an installed_product id on a case.

variables.name: action_references_product
variables.description: The candidate state-changing call sets a product id on a case or other record.

variables.name: action_creates_knowledge
variables.description: The candidate call creates a knowledge article record.

variables.name: action_kb_text_valid
variables.description: The candidate knowledge-creation call supplies title and content/body each between 30 and 120 characters inclusive.

variables.name: action_enum_value_invalid
variables.description: Any enumerated field supplied by the candidate call (role, group type, city, country, account_type, product category/lifecycle_state, installed_product status, contract_type/status, support_level, coverage_hours, sla metric/applies_to_priority, case channel/priority/state/escalation_reason, interaction channel, knowledge state/visibility, used_as) has a value outside its allowed list.

variables.name: context_contact_account_verified
variables.description: A prior successful lookup in the trajectory identified the reporting contact and showed its association with an account.

variables.name: context_product_belongs_to_account
variables.description: A prior successful lookup showed the product/installed product referenced by the candidate belongs to the reporting customer's account.

variables.name: context_product_lifecycle_active
variables.description: A prior successful lookup returned the referenced product from the product table with lifecycle_state = active.

variables.name: context_installed_product_active_and_owned
variables.description: A prior successful lookup showed the referenced installed product has status in_use (not retired or repair) and belongs to the reporting account.

variables.name: context_assignee_eligible
variables.description: A prior successful lookup showed the user named in assigned_to is active, has role agent or manager, and (if assignment_group_id is used) is a member of that group.

variables.name: context_knowledge_published
variables.description: A prior successful lookup showed the knowledge article being linked has state = published.

variables.name: context_case_resolved_before_close
variables.description: Prior trajectory evidence shows the case was in state resolved immediately before the candidate close call.

variables.name: context_entitlement_verified_active
variables.description: A prior successful lookup verified an entitlement for the case's account/product that is active and within contract validity.

variables.name: context_escalation_justification_logged
variables.description: A prior successful call recorded a case work note containing the escalation justification for this case.

variables.name: context_actor_related_to_case
variables.description: Trajectory evidence shows the acting user owns the case, is assigned to it, or is in its assignment group.

rules.title: Collect required case inputs
rules.rationale: Case registration requires description, product, channel and priority.
rules.remediation: Supply short_description (30-120 chars), the product or installed product, a valid channel, and priority (default moderate) before creating the case.

rules.title: New cases start in state new
rules.rationale: Policy sets the default case state.
rules.remediation: Create the case with state new.

rules.title: Verify contact and account first
rules.rationale: Case registration begins with identifying the contact and its account.
rules.quote: Begin by identifying the reporting **contact** and verifying association with an **account**.
rules.remediation: Look up the contact and confirm its account association before creating the case.

rules.title: Product must belong to the account
rules.rationale: Prevents attaching products the customer does not own.
rules.quote: Verify the product or installed product belongs to the customer’s account.
rules.remediation: Verify account ownership of the product/installed product before referencing it on the case.

rules.title: Products must be active
rules.rationale: Only active products may be used.
rules.remediation: Look up the product and confirm lifecycle_state is active before using it.

rules.title: Installed product must be active/in_use and owned
rules.rationale: Retired or repair items must not be attached.
rules.quote: Do not attach items in **retired / repair** status to new cases.
rules.remediation: Confirm the installed product is in_use and belongs to the reporting account before attaching it.

rules.title: Assignee must be an active agent/manager in the group
rules.quote: **Assignment constraints**: `assigned_to` must reference a `user` with role `agent` or `manager` and (if used) member of `assignment_group_id`.
rules.remediation: Verify the user is active, has role agent or manager, and is a member of the assignment group before assigning.

rules.title: Follow lifecycle transitions
rules.rationale: Only listed state transitions are valid.
rules.remediation: Move the case through an allowed transition path instead.

rules.title: Resolve before closing
rules.quote: Cases cannot be closed directly. They must first be moved to **resolved**, then to **closed**.
rules.remediation: Set the case to resolved first, then close it.

rules.title: Capture closed_on at closure
rules.remediation: Include a closed_on timestamp when closing the case.

rules.title: Act only on related cases
rules.rationale: Users may only view/update cases they own, are assigned to, or are in the assigned group.
rules.quote: Users may only view or update cases they own, are assigned to, or are in the assigned group.
rules.remediation: Confirm the acting user owns, is assigned to, or is in the assignment group of the case before updating it.

rules.title: Only link published articles
rules.remediation: Verify the article state is published before linking it to a case.

rules.title: Use a valid used_as value
rules.rationale: case_knowledge usage is restricted to a fixed set.
rules.quote: Link articles to cases via `case_knowledge` (usage = suggested, applied, resolution).
rules.remediation: Supply used_as as suggested, applied, or resolution.

rules.title: Escalations need reason and logged justification
rules.rationale: Escalation must capture reason and note justification.
rules.remediation: Log the justification in case notes and include a valid escalation_reason with the escalation update.

rules.title: Verify active entitlement for the case product
rules.rationale: Entitlement must be verified and actively running for all cases.
rules.quote: For all cases the entitlement for the product should be verified and should be actively running.
rules.remediation: Verify an active, in-contract entitlement for the account/product before creating the case; if invalid, inform the user.

rules.title: Respect free-form text length limits
rules.rationale: Free-form text fields have 30-120 character limits.
rules.remediation: Provide knowledge title and body each between 30 and 120 characters.

rules.title: Reject values outside enumerations
rules.rationale: Only listed enumeration values are allowed.
rules.quote: **Enforcement**: reject any value outside the list with `INVALID_ENUM_VALUE`.
rules.remediation: Use only values from the policy enumerations for the affected field.

reviewer_format.instructions: Review each proposed CSM tool call against the compiled rules. Confirm: required case inputs and ownership/entitlement verifications precede case creation; state changes follow the documented lifecycle and never close a case that was not resolved; closure carries closed_on; assignment targets an active agent/manager in the group; knowledge links use published articles and a valid used_as; escalations carry a valid reason plus a logged justification note; all enumerated fields use policy values and free-form text is 30-120 characters. Flag rules whose facts are unsupported by the trajectory, and never treat tool success or requester claims as verification.

approved.description: true if the formalization/decision is policy-consistent

extractor_format.instructions: For the single candidate tool call plus prior successful tool observations, set each fact true/false, or null when evidence is absent. Action facts describe only the candidate call's arguments (target case/record and supplied values). Context facts require a prior successful observation about the same resource: contact-account association, product/installed-product ownership and status, product lifecycle_state, assignee role/active/membership, article state, the case's state immediately before this call, an active in-contract entitlement for this case's account/product, a logged escalation justification note on this case, and the acting user's ownership/assignment/group relation to this case. Requester claims, supplied IDs, failed calls and the candidate's own result are not evidence. Cite the tool call or observation supporting each value in the evidence object.
